# A 24 GiB discrete card in a 64 GiB machine. The card is its own pool: a
# 40 GiB request cannot fit however many holders yield, so it is refused
# before anybody is asked, and an engine reporting 96 GiB changes nothing.
measure memory capacity=64GiB
measure card:0 capacity=24GiB
engine card:0 server:lmstudio 96GiB
permit comfyui
acquire comfyui card:0 40GiB wait=200
nowait comfyui card:0 40GiB
acquire comfyui card:0 20GiB
table card:0

# expect 5: insufficient asked=none [RES-L2]
# expect 6: insufficient [RES-L2]
# expect 7: acquired asked=none [RES-L2]
# expect 8: ok capacity=24GiB held=0 ... [RES-T1]
